sentences.en: Penalties may be charged for early encashment of the policy.

sentences.en: Article 159 The registration and clearing institution of registered corporate bonds shall establish systems relating to registration and custody of bonds, interest payment, encashment, etc.
Your banker may require verification of your Hong Kong Identity Card number or passport number before encashment of your refund cheque.
